justifications.fit: tests/test_queue_order.py:80 follows the file's idiom (typed no-arg test, _queued helper, UTC now) and imports nothing new; queue_order.admission_order is the real production entry point (reckon/crew/runs.py:613).

justifications.reuse: the change adds no production code and no duplicate case; it reuses the existing admission_order and the file's shared _queued helper, and the new case is distinct from the alternation case.
justifications.scope_discipline: the delta a0f0bdef..8d9fe6aff touches only tests/test_queue_order.py, a declared write path; queue_order.py is unchanged.
